```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

## Workload and checks

This repeats the synthetic scaling workload from
[the low-pass calibration report](benchmark_count_mixture_lowpass.md).
The existing `count_mixture_lowpass/memory_worker.R` generates the input view.
No external corpus is needed.

The site axis has 100,000, 200,000, and 400,000 sites, with one sample and candidate.
The group axis has 100,000 sites and (samples, candidates) of (1,1), (2,1), and (2,2).
Each query returns one unrelated-model row per sample/candidate pair.
All positions fit within one 1 Mb block per group. This tests input scaling,
not scaling in the number of jackknife blocks.

Each configuration runs three times, sequentially, in fresh R processes.
Each query uses one DuckDB thread, a 3 GB memory limit, and CPU affinity 0–5.
Query time excludes startup, extension loading, and view creation.
Peak process RSS includes those costs. DuckDB profiling supplies peak buffers and spill.

The memory ceiling is unchanged: 512 MiB plus three times modeled live state
(768 bytes per SQL input row and 1,024 bytes per native block/group).
Every run must satisfy that ceiling for RSS and buffers, without spill.
Results are aligned by `(sample, candidate, relationship_model)`; SQL row order
is not specified. Duplicate keys fail the check. Every column must then be
identical to baseline, including counters, fit values, statuses, and missing
values. No rows or results are filtered.

The baseline is built from source revision
`0d765acb8f8eaf16931852ac37079c5668cd6c51`.
The candidate runs on both R DuckDB engines. Comparing baseline and candidate
on DuckDB 1.5 isolates the SQL change; comparing engines also includes engine changes.
The baseline query is rejected by DuckDB 2.0's window binder, so it has no 2.0 timing.

## Reproduction

Build the baseline from an archive of its revision and build the candidate
with `make release -j2`. Run from the repository root after other build and test jobs finish:

```r
rmarkdown::render("benchmarks/benchmark_duckdb2_lowpass.Rmd", params = list(
  run = TRUE,
  baseline_extension = Sys.getenv("BASELINE_EXTENSION"),
  candidate_extension = Sys.getenv("CANDIDATE_EXTENSION"),
  duckdb2_library = Sys.getenv("DUCKDB2_R_LIB")
))
```

Both extensions use the same release build settings. The measurement chunk
starts each worker with `taskset -c 0-5`. Set `run = FALSE` to render stored results.

```{r measure, include=FALSE}
results_path <- "benchmarks/count_mixture_lowpass/results/duckdb2_compatibility.csv"
if (params$run) local({
  stopifnot(system2("git", c("diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--",
    "src/count_mixture_sql.c", "src/count_mixture_model.c", "src/count_mixture_udf.c")) == 0L)
  revision <- system2("git", c("rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE)
  extensions <- c(baseline = normalizePath(params$baseline_extension, mustWork = TRUE),
                  candidate = normalizePath(params$candidate_extension, mustWork = TRUE))
  library2 <- normalizePath(params$duckdb2_library, mustWork = TRUE)
  scratch <- tempfile("lowpass-compatibility-", tmpdir = dirname(tempdir()))
  dir.create(scratch)
  message("Worker results and diagnostics: ", scratch)
  variants <- c("baseline_1.5", "candidate_1.5", "candidate_2.0")
  references <- list()
  runs <- list()
  old_library <- Sys.getenv("R_LIBS_USER", unset = NA_character_)
  on.exit(if (is.na(old_library)) Sys.unsetenv("R_LIBS_USER") else
    Sys.setenv(R_LIBS_USER = old_library))
  cpu_model <- sub("^model name[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*", "",
                   grep("^model name", readLines("/proc/cpuinfo"), value = TRUE)[1])
  for (variant in variants) {
    if (variant == "candidate_2.0") Sys.setenv(R_LIBS_USER = library2)
    else if (is.na(old_library)) Sys.unsetenv("R_LIBS_USER")
    else Sys.setenv(R_LIBS_USER = old_library)
    extension <- extensions[[if (variant == "baseline_1.5") "baseline" else "candidate"]]
    extension_hash <- strsplit(system2("sha256sum", shQuote(extension), stdout = TRUE), " ")[[1]][1]
    engine <- system2("Rscript", c("--vanilla", "-e", shQuote(paste(
      "con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(shared_home=FALSE));",
      "v <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, 'PRAGMA version');",
      "cat(v$library_version, v$source_id, paste0('R-package-', utils::packageVersion('duckdb')));",
      "DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown=TRUE)"))), stdout = TRUE)
    stopifnot(length(engine) == 1L, grepl("^v[12]\\.", engine))
    for (axis in c("sites", "groups")) for (factor in c(1L, 2L, 4L)) {
      sites <- 100000L * if (axis == "sites") factor else 1L
      groups <- if (axis == "groups") factor else 1L
      for (repeat_id in 1:3) {
        key <- paste(axis, factor, repeat_id, sep = "-")
        output <- file.path(scratch, paste0(variant, "-", key, ".rds"))
        log <- paste0(output, ".log")
        rss <- paste0(output, ".rss")
        status <- system2("/usr/bin/time", c("-f", "%M", "-o", shQuote(rss),
          "taskset", "-c", "0-5", "Rscript", "--vanilla",
          shQuote(c("benchmarks/count_mixture_lowpass/memory_worker.R", "unordered",
                    sites, 1L, output, extension, groups))), stdout = log, stderr = log)
        if (status != 0L) stop("Worker failed; retained log: ", log)
        result <- readRDS(output)
        stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(result$result[c("sample", "candidate", "relationship_model")]))
        result$result <- result$result[order(result$result$sample, result$result$candidate,
                                             result$result$relationship_model), , drop = FALSE]
        rownames(result$result) <- NULL
        if (variant == "baseline_1.5") references[[key]] <- result$result
        exact <- identical(result$result, references[[key]])
        peak_rss <- as.numeric(readLines(rss)) * 1024
        ceiling_bytes <- 512 * 1024^2 + 3 * (result$input_rows * 768 + groups * 1024)
        runs[[length(runs) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          variant, engine, R_version = R.version.string, cpu_model,
          source_revision = if (variant == "baseline_1.5")
            "0d765acb8f8eaf16931852ac37079c5668cd6c51" else revision,
          extension_sha256 = extension_hash, axis, factor, repeat_id,
          sites, samples = result$samples, candidates = result$candidates,
          input_rows = result$input_rows, output_rows = result$output_rows,
          threads = result$threads, seconds = result$seconds, rss_bytes = peak_rss,
          buffer_bytes = result$buffer_bytes, spill_bytes = result$temp_bytes,
          ceiling_bytes, exact,
          result_sha256 = digest::digest(result$result, algo = "sha256"))
        write.csv(do.call(rbind, runs), results_path, row.names = FALSE)
        stopifnot(exact, result$output_rows == groups, peak_rss <= ceiling_bytes,
                  result$buffer_bytes <= ceiling_bytes, result$temp_bytes == 0)
      }
    }
  }
})
runs <- read.csv(results_path)
stopifnot(nrow(runs) == 54L, all(runs$exact), all(runs$spill_bytes == 0),
          all(runs$rss_bytes <= runs$ceiling_bytes),
          all(runs$buffer_bytes <= runs$ceiling_bytes))
```

## Results

```{r provenance}
knitr::kable(unique(runs[c("variant", "engine", "source_revision", "extension_sha256")]))
knitr::kable(unique(runs[c("R_version", "cpu_model")]))
```

```{r measurements}
grouped <- split(runs, interaction(runs$variant, runs$axis, runs$factor, drop = TRUE))
summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(grouped, function(x) data.frame(
  variant = x$variant[1], axis = x$axis[1], factor = x$factor[1],
  input_rows = x$input_rows[1], output_rows = x$output_rows[1], threads = x$threads[1],
  median_seconds = median(x$seconds), min_seconds = min(x$seconds), max_seconds = max(x$seconds),
  peak_rss_MiB = max(x$rss_bytes)/1024^2,
  peak_buffers_MiB = max(x$buffer_bytes)/1024^2, ceiling_MiB = x$ceiling_bytes[1]/1024^2)))
rownames(summary) <- NULL
knitr::kable(summary, digits = 3)
```

All 54 results match their baseline exactly. All runs satisfy the memory ceilings
without spill. The one-times workloads are shorter than five seconds; under the
existing declaration, this does not support a timing-exponent verdict.
The table reports all timing ranges rather than selecting favorable runs.

The historical identical workload is retained in
[count_mixture_lowpass/results/scaling.csv](count_mixture_lowpass/results/scaling.csv).
Its environment differs from this run, so it is context rather than a regression control.
This report measures only the low-pass query. It does not measure cgranges
throughput or BGZF compression/decompression throughput.
